question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.**

These buildings __will demolish__ by the end of this year.
solution:
The correct answer is: **will be demolished**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Replace** 'will demolish'** with **'will be demolished'** to make the sentence correct.
 
• The given sentence is written in the passive form of the Future tense 
 
• The future tense used for **actions that will be completed before some other point in the future.**
 
• In the given sentence it is said that **'by the end of this year'** which means it will be completed in the future.
 
• The passive verb form in the simple future tense is made by putting **will / shall + be before the past participle form of the verb__.**
 
• **Example - **
 __
 
• *We will play football* (Active)
 
• *Football will be played by us* (Passive)
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

**Corrected sentence:** *These buildings **will be demolished__** by the end of this year.*
